triage.kind_span: The Gabelli Utility Trust (the “Fund,” “we,” “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common shareholders to purchase additional common shares

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Utility Trust (the “Fund,” “we,” “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common shareholders to purchase additional common shares

subject_tickers.span: Common Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol “GUT.”

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Acquire Common Shares

rights_per_share.span: One transferable subscription right (a “Right”) will be issued for each common share of the Fund

rights_per_new_share.span: Seven Rights will be required to purchase one Common Share.

price_reference.span: Seven Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share (the “Subscription Price”).

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares as of the close business on March 11, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on April 14, 2021 (the “Expiration Date”), unless otherwise extended.

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “GUT RT”.

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered, subject to the right of the Board of Trustees of the Fund (the “Board”) to eliminate the over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: 7,885,840 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement dated March 11, 2021 (to base prospectus dated November 17, 2020, which follows in the same document) for a transferable rights offering of The Gabelli Utility Trust: 55,200,877 Rights for 7,885,840 Common Shares, one Right per share, seven Rights per new share, fixed Subscription Price $5.50 (so price_reference=fixed and price_pct/price_floor_pct_nav are null; no NAV- or market-linked formula or floor is stated). Record date: the cover summary and the Important Dates table both say March 11, 2021, but the 'Terms of the Rights Offering' paragraph says 'March 11, 2020 (the “Record Date”'; 2021 was used as the consistent, plausible value and the field is flagged. Subscription Period March 11, 2021 through April 14, 2021, 5:00 PM ET, unless extended; payment/notice of guaranteed delivery due April 16, 2021; issuance April 20, 2021. Rights trade on NYSE as 'GUT RT'; only GUT (common) is given as the subject ticker (preferreds GUT PrA / GUT PrC are not the subject). Over-subscription privilege is limited to Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise, and the Board may eliminate it up to the fifth day after expiration. Fund states NAV $4.18 vs price $7.35 on March 10, 2021 (premium 76.00%); subscription price is above NAV. No over-allotment or secondary option is stated; max_new_shares is the primary-subscription count.
